entities.summary: Nam Kon was a Korean politician, poet, Neo-Confucian scholar, thinker, writer and Prime Minister during the Joseon period. His art names were Chijŏng, Chijoktang and Chijok, while his courtesy name was Sahwa. He was also a member of the Sarim faction.
